title: The Feed composer is a kit card: a prompt row and labelled Photo, Event, Log practice and Listing actions (LIVE-1083)

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-20: double check every item from the design list and make sure it is fully evolved (item 24, kit composer). Render in /mnt/project-files/changed-plan/feed-composer-after-phone.png.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-20. The Feed composer was one pill with four icon-only buttons. It is now a glass card: avatar and prompt on top, then labelled Photo, Event, Log practice and Listing chips that wrap on a phone. Behavior is unchanged (the prompt and Photo open the capture bar; the others link out).
